name: superplan
description: Linux adaptive checkpoint-and-restore planning with bounded compaction recovery for Codex and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: Adaptive persistent planning for Codex and Claude Code (Linux/WSL)
interface.longDescription: Persist AI-authored task plans, durable findings, and progress with sparse adaptive mid-turn checkpoints, bounded pre-compaction transcript recovery, and automatic post-compaction reconciliation. Works in both Codex and Claude Code.
defaultPrompt: Use $superplan to keep persistent planning files for this task.
